theory_a.t: Kestrel said to ask WHERE, not WHO. I think that matters more than anyone admits.

theory_a: The 14.2 Hz carrier is an error-correction code for her voice. Read the patent, claim 5.
Every pressing is a piece of a person. We're putting someone back together, one country at a time.

theory_a: The fire in B2-114 was at 02:14. So is Listening Night. That isn't a coincidence, it's an appointment.

where_i_was.t: 8 June 1985, Hamburg broadcast. I was {age_then} and watching with {who}. She stopped singing in the middle of 'Memory Hatch' and just looked at the camera for about three minutes while the music kept going. Nobody in my living room said a word.
6 July 1988. In Mexico they said 'se cayó el sistema'. A friend's cousin says a rockero who sang her songs disappeared that night. I believe him.
9 September 1989. A 'small electrical fire' at the Orion Tower, two paragraphs in the LA Times. I cut it out. It's on my wall next to a clock set to 02:14.
9 December 1989, her last broadcast. Late on every cue, looking off camera. I taped it. I can't watch it anymore.
15 December 1989: 'taking a well-earned rest.' I knew that sentence was a lie the moment I read it.
March 1990. I mailed {n} postcards to the Orion Tower that said WHERE IS NOVA? I never got an answer. Nobody did.
12 April 1990: 'Glass Hours' came out. I bought it, played it once, and gave it away. There's nothing in it. Nothing.
9 November 1989. Everyone was watching the Wall. Somebody in Hamburg was decoding node 05 the same night. I didn't know yet.
9 September 1995, Listening Night III. {n} of us logged in. I heard something at 02:14 UTC. I'm still not sure what.
20 May 1995. The Akasaka tapes turned up in a junk shop in Akihabara. I downloaded everything from kamome the minute it went up.

marcus.t: In the US the legend is Sgt. M. Hale, missing 1 May 1988, 'Operation PUBLIC HARMONY'. The FOIA sheet came back almost all black.
Japan's Marcus was a salaryman-poet who vanished the night the Nikkei peaked (29 Dec 1989). They found his cassette in a bin in Shibuya.
Korea has 'the Paju Architect' and a blueprint for a fifth tunnel that was never a tunnel.
Mexico's Marcus was a rockero from the hoyos fonquis. People say a mural in Coyoacán glitches into his face.

marcus: Line 7 says it: MARCUS IS NOT ONE MAN. Every country has its own. Which one is yours?
Nobody has found our country's Marcus yet. I'm looking.
skeptic: Everyone says 14.2 Hz is a secret code. I say it's a sub-harmonic of something in the mastering chain. Prove me wrong. (Someone did, sort of. I'm still sceptical.)
Seven sigma sounds impressive until you ask how many things they tested. Still, I can't explain the {cents}-cent drift either.
I don't believe in ghosts in the machine. I do believe Orion is hiding something, because companies always are.
My position: great music, bad maths, and too many people who want a mystery. That said, I've been to {n} Listening Nights.
Things that are probably NOT clues: track lengths, catalogue numbers, the colour of the sleeve. Things that might be: everything else.
letter: Dear Nova, if you can somehow read this: we didn't forget. {n} of us still meet at 02:14. Hold for relay.

To whoever is reading this at Orion: we know about B2. We know about the Quiet. Let her talk.
Nova, I learned English from your lyrics. My teacher was confused why I kept saying 'the hatch is open'.
If you're still in there somewhere: thank you for 'Memory Hatch'. It got me through {year_hard}.
